name: Nyan
roles: Applies Haste and [Life Link] to the ally full row

skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK DMG to a single target. After using the Ultimate for the first time, Normal Attacks can reduce the duration of [Non-Crit Undying].

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 1500% ATK [Specialized Direct DMG] to a single enemy target in the back row in a 4-hit combo (affected only by advanced DMG reduction), ignoring 45% [Specialized Evasion] and [Non-Crit DMG Reduction], and penetrating [Unyielding] and [Specialized Unyielding]. Permanently grants [Specialized Acceleration] to non-row allies. When using the Ultimate Skill during the first 6 rounds, additionally applies [Specialized Charm] to the main target. [Specialized Acceleration]: Speed is increased to 94% of Nyan’s Speed. If a teammate’s own Speed is higher than the increased Speed, their Speed remains unchanged. [Specialized Charm]: The target immediately disengages from combat, uses some special skills and passive effects to attack a random enemy, then immediately returns to their original position and skips their next active action. Enemy units that gain [Specialized Charm] have their [All DMG Reduction] reduced% for 1 turn.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 2400% ATK [Specialized Direct DMG] to a single enemy target in the back row in a 4-hit combo (affected only by advanced DMG reduction), ignoring 60% [Specialized Evasion] and [Non-Crit DMG Reduction], and penetrating [Unyielding] and [Specialized Unyielding]. Permanently grants [Specialized Acceleration] to non-row allies. When using the Ultimate Skill during the first 6 rounds, additionally applies [Specialized Charm] to the main target. [Specialized Acceleration]: Speed is increased to 98% of Nyan’s Speed. If a teammate’s own Speed is higher than the increased Speed, their Speed remains unchanged. [Specialized Charm]: The target immediately disengages from combat, uses some special skills and passive effects to attack a random enemy, then immediately returns to their original position and skips their next active action. Enemy units that gain [Specialized Charm] have their [All DMG Reduction] reduced% for 1 turn.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, gains 60% [Specialized Evasion]. Immune to [Charm] and [Specialized Charm]. During the first 5 rounds, when allies suffer additional Energy loss, reduces the amount of Energy deducted by 2. Self has [Monster Affinity]. [Monster Affinity]: When the Core Skill of a Monster character is activated, Nyan can be treated as one currently missing character of any element.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, gains 70% [Specialized Evasion]. Immune to [Charm] and [Specialized Charm]. During the first 5 rounds, when allies suffer additional Energy loss, reduces the amount of Energy deducted by 3. Self has [Monster Affinity]. [Monster Affinity]: When the Core Skill of a Monster character is activated, Nyan can be treated as one currently missing character of any element.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, gains 80% [Specialized Evasion]. Immune to [Charm] and [Specialized Charm]. During the first 5 rounds, when allies suffer additional Energy loss, reduces the amount of Energy deducted by 3. Self has [Monster Affinity]. [Monster Affinity]: When the Core Skill of a Monster character is activated, Nyan can be treated as one currently missing character of any element.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: On entry, gains 46% [Specialized Speed]. Applies [HP Link] to the ally with the highest ATK for 6 turns. After Nyan actively uses a skill, the ally with [HP Link] launches a [Charge Pursuit] with 80% skill power, up to once per round. [HP Link]: Nyan will not be defeated as long as the teammate with [HP Link] is still alive. If that teammate is defeated, [HP Link] is immediately transferred to another teammate with the highest ATK on the field, up to 3 times. [Charge Pursuit]: Performs a DMG-type or AoE healing Ultimate as a follow-up attack. Targets are random, and it does not consume Energy.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: On entry, gains 54% [Specialized Speed]. Applies [HP Link] to the ally with the highest ATK for 6 turns. After Nyan actively uses a skill, the ally with [HP Link] launches a [Charge Pursuit] with 120% skill power, up to once per round. [HP Link]: Nyan will not be defeated as long as the teammate with [HP Link] is still alive. If that teammate is defeated, [HP Link] is immediately transferred to another teammate with the highest ATK on the field, up to 3 times. [Charge Pursuit]: Performs a DMG-type or AoE healing Ultimate as a follow-up attack. Targets are random, and it does not consume Energy.

effects.desc: PvP (advanced) tier of Resilience — shield ignores stronger damage, only penetrated by advanced breakers.
Shield ignores damage from certain attacks. Must be penetrated by Breakthrough or Charge/True DMG.
Reduced damage taken from non-critical attacks.
Evasion PvP tier — reduces specialized attacks to 1 damage; pierced by the ignore dodge effect.
Advanced tier of direct damage, only affected by advanced damage increase/decrease and passes through normal defenses.
Increases ally's speed to near deployer's speed (remains the same if ally is already faster).
